title: VisApex
description:
About This SoftwareVisApex transforms your existing webcam into a smooth, responsive, and accurate AI-powered 6DoF head tracking solution for sim racing, flight simulation, trucking, and many other games. No IR camera, reflective clip, phone, or additional hardware required.

Turn your head to naturally control the in-game camera. Look into corners, check mirrors, look over your wings, or scan the cockpit just as you would in real life.

Designed with a strong focus on sim racing, VisApex combines advanced AI, practical sim racing features and powerful tuning tools to help you get the most from your simulator.

Looking for Assetto Corsa EVO head tracking? VisApex supports it!Feature HighlightsAI Webcam Head TrackingAdvanced AI-powered webcam head tracking for smooth, responsive, and accurate movement.

Just Need a WebcamNo IR camera, reflective clip, phone, or additional hardware required. Supports a wide range of webcams, including the PS3 Eye at 320×240 @ 120 FPS.

SteamVR Virtual HMD (Experimental)Experimental SteamVR Virtual HMD support provides head tracking in supported VR-capable games without requiring a physical VR headset.

Currently intended for Assetto Corsa EVO and Automobilista 2. As an experimental feature, compatibility and functionality may vary.

Works in Low LightReliable tracking in dim indoor lighting with a suitable webcam.

Smooth & ResponsiveLow latency and minimal jitter for smooth, precise camera control.

Optional opentrack SupportUse VisApex on its own or optionally send tracking data to OpenTrack or compatible game mods through OpenTrack UDP.

Easy to Fine-TuneBuilt-in previews and performance monitoring make fine-tuning quick and easy.

Configurable Shortcut KeysMultiple configurable shortcut key to control head tracking. Including Pause (holding your last position) and Zero (holding at your center position).

Configurable Profiles and Game Auto DetectCreate multiple profiles for each game and auto load when game started.

Broad CompatibilitySupports many racing and flight simulators through industry-standard head-tracking protocols.

Extra Sim Racing FeaturesVisApex includes practical sim racing tools designed to help you work around common hardware and game limitations while preserving an authentic driving experience.

Features include:

• Virtual Controller – XInput and vJoy output with customizable controller mapping for a wide range of racing hardware and games.

• Auto Clutch – Enables H-pattern shifting with 2-pedal setups in games without built-in clutch support or with unreliable auto-clutch implementations.

• Reverse Gear Protection – Helps prevent accidental shifts into reverse on H-pattern shifters without a physical reverse lockout.

Getting StartedGetting started is simple.

• Connect your webcam.

• Start VisApex and begin tracking.

• Launch your game.

• Fine-tune your setup using the built-in preview and tuning tools.

Many games work immediately through standard head-tracking protocols, while others require a one-time in-game option to be enabled.

Customize Your ExperienceAdjust VisApex to match your driving or flying style.

• Camera selection and quality setting

• Sensitivity and response curves

• Profiles and presets

• Output protocol selection

• Keyboard shortcuts

• Virtual Controller mapping

• Customizable user interface

Whether you prefer subtle camera movement or aggressive cockpit look-around, VisApex gives you complete control over your tracking experience.

Supported GamesVisApex supports many popular racing and flight simulators through industry-standard head-tracking protocols, including:

Racing & Driving• Assetto Corsa

• Assetto Corsa Competizione

• Assetto Corsa EVO

• Automobilista 2

• BeamNG.drive

• iRacing

• Le Mans Ultimate

• EA SPORTS F1 series

• RaceRoom

• Euro Truck Simulator 2

• American Truck Simulator

...and many more.

Flight & Space• Microsoft Flight Simulator

• DCS World

• X-Plane

• Elite Dangerous

• War Thunder

...and many more.

Others• NoLimits 2 - Roller Coaster Simulation

• Arma 3

...and many more.

PrivacyEverything runs locally on your computer. VisApex does not collect or transmit telemetry, analytics, or head tracking data.

Free DemoNot sure if VisApex is right for you?

Try the full-featured demo with your own webcam, hardware, and favorite games before purchasing.

The demo includes the same head tracking, tuning, Virtual Controller, Auto Clutch, Reverse Gear Protection, and experimental SteamVR Virtual HMD features as the full version. Only the duration of each session is limited. The demo does not expire.

Test compatibility, evaluate performance, and experience the tracking quality with your own setup before making a purchase.
description_short: Turn your webcam into smooth, responsive AI-powered head tracking. Naturally look into corners, check mirrors, or look over your wings by simply turning your head. Includes exclusive sim racing features and a free demo.
